priorityList: Maintain Flame Shock on your primary target to ensure consistent damage over time.
Cast Ascendance on cooldown to trigger Thorim's Invocation and empower your attacks.
Cast Doom Winds on cooldown to maximize Windfury procs and AoE pressure.
Use offensive Trinkets and Potions during Ascendance or Doom Winds for maximum burst alignment.
Cast Tempest if you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon, unless both Ascendance and Doom Winds are active.
Cast Primordial Storm if you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon and Tempest is unavailable.
Cast Sundering if Feral Spirit is active or if you have the Surging Elements talent.
Cast Crash Lightning to maintain your AoE cleave buff or to trigger Thorim's Invocation lightning strikes during Ascendance or Doom Winds.
Cast Chain Lightning as your primary Maelstrom spender when at 9 or more stacks.
Cast Windstrike (available during Ascendance) as your highest priority filler.
Cast Voltaic Blaze whenever it becomes available through procs or talent conditions.
Cast Stormstrike if you have nearly two charges or have reached maximum stacks of Converging Storms.
Cast Lava Lash as a filler, prioritizing it if Hot Hand is active or to spread Flame Shock.
Cast Stormstrike as a general filler if no higher priority melee abilities are available.
Cast Chain Lightning at 5 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks if no other abilities are ready.
